Confirmed: no DELETE route exists in `character.ts` — only matched the filename, no actual delete logic/endpoint.

**Login** — client-side only, no server auth. `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`) loads/creates a `UserProfile` from `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<username.toLowerCase()>` (plus a "last used" copy at `ai_dnd_user`). No password/token. `authGuard` (`auth.guard.ts`) just checks `isLoggedIn()` (profile non-null) to gate routes. `LoginComponent.login()` calls this then navigates.

**Campaigns storage** — Each `UserProfile.campaigns: CampaignSlot[]` (model in `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`) is persisted entirely client-side in `localStorage` via `AuthService.persist()`. A `CampaignSlot` just holds `slotId`, `sessionId`, `characterId`, and display info — it's a pointer to server data, not the data itself.

**Deleting a campaign slot** — `LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` → `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)` filters the slot out of `profile.campaigns` and rewrites `localStorage`. This **only removes the local pointer**; it makes no API call. The actual server-side character row in D1 (`characters` table, accessed via `worker/src/services/character.ts`) and the KV session (`worker/src/services/session.ts`, key `session:<id>`, 7-day TTL) are **never deleted** — they remain orphaned until the KV session naturally expires; the D1 character row persists indefinitely with no cleanup path.
